                if (mr+y, mcol+x) in mcells:
                    tile[y+2][x+2] = mc
        tiles.append((fr, fcol, tile))

    groups = []
    for item in tiles:
        if not groups or item[0] != groups[-1][0][0]:
            groups.append([item])
        else:
            groups[-1].append(item)

    out = []
    for group in groups:
        group.sort(key=lambda t: t[1])
        for y in range(10):
            out.append([v for _, _, tile in group for v in tile[y]])
    return out
